title: Hardship Goodwill on Mobile Wallet Shortfalls for Medical, Education and Family Support Transfers
content:
Customer care hardship policy for **Mobile Wallet** transfers that arrived short.

**Hardship goodwill.** The hardship goodwill on a shortfall make-good follows the transfer purpose stated at booking together with the shortfall as a percentage of the disclosed amount to be credited (the disclosed amount less what the credit-sent entries delivered, divided by the disclosed amount, times 100):

| Stated transfer purpose | Shortfall more than 2.0 percent of the disclosed amount | Hardship goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| medical or education | yes | 4.0 percent |
| family support | yes | 2.0 percent |
| medical, education or family support | no (2.0 percent or less) | nothing |
| any other purpose | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases (disclosed amount 28000.00)

| Purpose | Delivered | Shortfall share | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|---|
| education | 27300.00 | 700.00 is 2.5 percent | 4.0 percent |
| family support | 27300.00 | 2.5 percent | 2.0 percent |
| medical | 27440.00 | 560.00 is exactly 2.0 percent, not more | nothing |
| a purpose other than medical, education or family support | 26000.00 | about 7.1 percent | nothing |
